PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL SECTION - FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, NOTES, AND REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION
NOTE 18 Public-Private Partnerships

KEY FACTS:
- NASA engages in relationships with private entities referred informally as "public-private partnerships."
- SFFAS 49, Public-Private Partnerships: Disclosure Requirements sets criteria for financial benefit or risk sharing relationships.
- NASA collaborates with private entities for commercial space capabilities in accordance with the National Space Policy of the United States.
- NASA utilizes 51 U.S.C. § 20101 et seq., and procurement contract authority (FAR and NASA FAR Supplement (NFS) requirements) to execute agreements.
- NASA awarded FAR based firm fixed price contracts under a competitive broad area announcement procurement titled "Next Space Technologies for Exploration Partnerships" (NextSTEP).
